preset.title: Preset
preset.description: A ready-made policy: keys_never (every credential kind must ask before sending), client_names (client and matter details must ask), or clinic (patient and staff identifiers must ask). Your other settings are added on top; an explicit requiredResponses entry beats the preset's.

orgName.title: Organization name
orgName.description: Shown to your people in Clotr and on the printed policy page. Up to 80 characters.

requiredResponses.title: Required responses
requiredResponses.description: Kinds of data (as in patterns.js, e.g. aws_access_key) and how Clotr must respond: block (ask before sending), warn or log. A floor, never a ceiling: a person may still choose a stricter response than this for themselves.

watchWords.title: Watch words
watchWords.description: Words or phrases (up to 4 words each, 200 at most) to warn about, e.g. project code names. A format with # for a digit and @ for a letter (at least 4 marks, no digits, for example EMP-#####) is watched as a format instead. Turned into one-way fingerprints on each computer; formats travel as typed (they aren't secret).

lockSettings.title: Lock settings
lockSettings.description: People can see but not change Clotr's settings or vault.
